o.text: From Proto-Common Turkic *tiken, equivalent to tikən, present participle of tikmək (“to sew”). Also, Compare to Southern Altai тегенек (tegenek), тиген (tigen, “fir”).
From təhlükəsiz + -lik. Calque of Russian безопа́сность (bezopásnostʹ).
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish آرقلمق (arıqlamaq). By surface analysis, arıq + -la.
